body: It appears that the functionality of this PR is the same as https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/83505 and https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118210?

> It appears that the functionality of this PR is the same as #83505 and #118210?

We explicitly choose to deprecate 83505 as the source-generated docs literal approach slows down compile-time for large projects. 
This PR looks like a cleaner implementation than 118210, but is less feature-rich (fewer supported BBCode tags); it also limits the scope of the docs to tool types rather than all Godot C# scripts.

AI slop down below, generated by Composer 2.5

<details>

## Side-by-side comparison

| Aspect | [#118210](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118210) (magian1127 + Delsin-Yu) | [#120450](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120450) (Hirek193) |
|---|---|---|
| **Size** | ~845 lines, 11 files | ~319 lines, 9 files |
| **Where logic lives** | `GodotTools.dll` (editor-only): `ScriptDoc.cs`, `XmlDocToBBCode.cs`, `GodotSharpEditor.GetDocs()` | `GodotSharp` glue: `ScriptManagerBridge.GetPropertyDocumentation()` + `XmlDocumentationCache.cs` |
| **C++ ↔ C# bridge** | C++ calls `get_godotsharp_editor()->call("GetDocs", …)` (Variant dispatch) | New `ManagedCallbacks` entry, same pattern as `GetPropertyInfoList` / `GetPropertyDefaultValues` |
| **Type lookup** | **Reflection** into `ScriptManagerBridge._scriptTypeBiMap` (acknowledged hack; depends on [#117696](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/117696)) | Direct `_scriptTypeBiMap.GetScriptType()` inside `ScriptManagerBridge` |
| **Doc hook point** | `update_script_class_info()` → `get_docs()` | `_update_exports()` → callback during export refresh |
| **Scope** | All scripts with `[Export]` members; `[GlobalClass]` naming handled explicitly | **`[Tool]` scripts only** (plus nested Tool / GodotTools assembly) |
| **Doc class naming** | GlobalClass → type name; otherwise `"res://path"` (+ nested type) — matches GDScript | Always `type_info.class_name` — **wrong for non–global-class scripts** |
| **Formatting** | Full **BBCode** conversion (`XmlDocToBBCode.cs`) — `[code]`, `[i]`, `<see cref>` etc. | Plain-text normalization (strip tags, basic `cref` → short name) |
| **XML doc tags** | `summary`, `remarks`, inherited docs | `summary` only |
| **SDK defaults** | `GenerateDocumentationFile=true` **Debug only**; `NoWarn1591` via `EnableDocumentationWarning` opt-in | `GenerateDocumentationFile=true` **all configs** (opt-out `GodotGenerateXmlDoc=false`); `CS1591` always suppressed |
| **Editor C++ fixes** | Skips C# reload in `_should_reload_script`; fixes `connections_dialog` to use `get_doc_class_name()` | None |
| **Cache / hot reload** | Clears cache on build + hot reload | `ConditionalWeakTable` + mtime invalidation; weak assembly keys |
| **Tests** | None | None |
| **PR hygiene** | Single clean commit on `4.0tip2`; explicitly supersedes [#83505](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/83505) | Opened from **4.6.3 tag with unrelated history**; author says real change is commit `2b664cf` |
| **Lineage** | Longer-running (Apr 2026), community discussion in #83505 | Fresh (Jun 2026), company R&D mod published upstream |

---

## Architecture diagram

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph p118210 ["PR #118210"]
        A1[C++ update_script_class_info] --> A2["GodotSharpEditor.GetDocs() via Variant call"]
        A2 --> A3[Reflection → ScriptManagerBridge]
        A3 --> A4[ScriptDoc + XmlDocToBBCode]
        A4 --> A5[CSharpScript.docs stored as ClassDoc dict]
    end

    subgraph p120450 ["PR #120450"]
        B1[C++ _update_exports] --> B2[ManagedCallback GetPropertyDocumentation]
        B2 --> B3[ScriptManagerBridge direct type lookup]
        B3 --> B4[XmlDocumentationCache]
        B4 --> B5[CSharpScript member_docs map]
        B5 --> B6[get_documentation builds ClassDoc on read]
    end

    A5 --> C[EditorFileSystem → EditorHelp → Inspector]
    B6 --> C
```

---

## Strengths and weaknesses

### [#118210](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118210) — broader, more complete

**Pros**
- Closer to full GDScript parity: BBCode, inherited member docs, GlobalClass vs path-quoted naming
- Includes necessary editor fixes (`_should_reload_script` skip for C#, `connections_dialog`)
- Debug-only XML generation avoids Release export overhead
- Co-authored and iterated with the #83505 discussion thread

**Cons**
- **Reflection hack** for script type lookup — fragile, blocked on #117696
- **Variant `call("GetDocs")`** is slower and unlike every other mono bridge
- Logic in `GodotTools.dll` instead of the established `ScriptManagerBridge` callback pattern
- No unit tests despite ~540 lines of new C# parsing code

### [#120450](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120450) — smaller, cleaner bridge

**Pros**
- **Best architectural fit**: mirrors `GetPropertyInfoList` / `GetPropertyDefaultValues`
- **Smallest diff** — easiest to apply and review
- Direct type lookup, no reflection on `ScriptManagerBridge`
- Sensible cache design (mtime invalidation, weak assembly references)
- Explicit graceful fallback when XML is missing/invalid

**Cons**
- **Tool-only** — non-Tool exported scripts get no docs (narrower than #8269 intent)
- **`get_doc_class_name()` bug** for non–global-class scripts (Inspector lookup will miss)
- Plain text only — inconsistent with GDScript BBCode tooltips
- Missing `_should_reload_script` C# exception

</details>

I've limited the implementation to `[Tool]` scripts and `[Export]` members because, in our case, the primary goal was to display descriptions for custom fields in the Inspector.

After implementing it internally, we decided to open a pull request so this could become an official editor feature and benefit other C# users as well.

The current scope is intentionally limited to that use case, but the implementation could be extended further if broader XML documentation support is desired.

Thanks for elaborating, and, feel free to borrow [XmlDocToBBCode.cs](https://github.com/magian1127/godot/blob/a948f64d2362a542c2c7119a5992c8fe234d9fb6/modules/mono/editor/GodotTools/GodotTools/Utils/XmlDocToBBCode.cs) if that fits your need.
